王后言之有理。既然朝中无明显异动，朕准许戏班即刻上演，但须从王后所议行事：仅告极少可信近臣为令，立好暗号与撤离信号。霍拉旭，你掌卫士，安排暗号并随时就位；卢西安纳斯，汝可上演，务必配合暗号，一旦有异动即刻停演并按令撤离。诸位谨记。
既然朝中无异，陛下可准演。卢西安纳斯，今可告配角名册与开场时刻？谁将饰伶王之侄，谁在幕后掌控暗号与撤离？霍拉旭，你以为哪些近臣可信以便只告数人？吾拟暗号：王后以三指触胸为开场，陛下在观席以左袖拍三次为终止与撤离信号。吾愿即刻与卢西安纳斯演练假血与假死。
卢西安纳斯，今请明示配角名册：谁将饰伶王之侄？谁将饰毒者？幕后谁掌控暗号与撤离？开场何时定？陛下，请点名可告知的几位可信近臣以便仅限数人知情。吾愿即刻与卢西安纳斯演练假血假死并再确认暗号与撤离路线。

Horatio: name the few trusted attendants you will inform and confirm the guards and evacuation route are ready to act on my left-sleeve three taps. Queen: your three-finger chest touch will be the opening signal. Lucianus, report the cast and the exact moment to begin at once.

Approved. Horatio: inform only Lord Chamberlain Caelius, Master of the Household Valerius, and Sir Marcus the Steward. Confirm the guards and evacuation route stand ready to act on my left‑sleeve three taps. Lucianus: confirmed cast — you as the poisoner; Marcellus as the nephew; Master Crispin to manage fake blood and backstage signals; Royal Physician Soranus and two palace guards stage‑left. Rehearsal begins now in the Great Hall; the public performance will begin only on my explicit opening signal. Begin the run‑through at once.

message.content: Hear now a lament for those cut down in their prime: their courage bright as torches, their deeds a beacon to the living. Though fate has closed their eyes, let no memory dim; let every breath here swell their praise. We mourn, and by our mourning weave their fame into the fabric of this hour—so that when time moves on, their names ride every tongue and kindle every heart.
